I've replied to Tobias in his DM. His standing call with Tansleigh Packaging is the **Osprey rollout call on Fridays at 16:15**. That comes from my notes on what he told me earlier in our own DMs, so it was fine to share with him.

I couldn't check it against a calendar: the calendar tool shows only my own events, and there were none. So I told him to look at his own calendar in case the time has changed.

I left out the other Tansleigh call in my notes (Pree's Moorland call). Pree told me that in a DM, and it isn't Tobias's call.
